As we wrap up, let's bring together what the Six Hats approach can mean for you.
This isn’t just a tool for meetings—it’s a whole new lens for thinking, listening, and working with others. By making our thinking more visible and structured, the Six Hats give us a chance to break free from old habits, spot new possibilities, and make better, more inclusive decisions.
So, what are the big takeaways?
First, remember to use each hat to zero in on one way of thinking at a time. Move through them in a clear, agreed order, and give equal space to facts, feelings, risks, benefits, and creativity. The Blue Hat is your guide—it keeps things on track and lets you adjust as you go.
Flexibility is key. Adapt the method to fit your situation, and encourage everyone to join in. Make it a habit—practice often, and let it become part of how your team works together. Don’t forget, the hats work just as well for personal reflection as they do for big group decisions.
If you stumble or things feel awkward at first, that’s totally normal. Change takes time, and old habits have a way of popping up. Just be gentle with yourself and your team—celebrate any progress, no matter how small. Over time, the hats become second nature, giving your conversations more depth, clarity, and creativity.
You don’t need to master every detail to start. Try using the hats in your next meeting, or even just to think through a personal choice. Maybe introduce the idea to a friend or colleague and see how it shifts the conversation. Notice what happens when everyone is focused in the same direction, even for a moment.
Most importantly, trust that every voice and every mode of thinking brings something valuable to the table. The Six Hats are an invitation to approach the world—and each other—with more curiosity, respect, and imagination.
In a world that often pushes us to move fast and be certain, this simple, structured method gives us space to make wiser, more human decisions—one hat at a time.
So, why not give it a try? Start small, keep an open mind, and let the journey begin.
